info.name: ND Downloader
info.summary: High-performance download manager for Nextcloud powered by an external ND / Motrix download server
info.description:
ND Downloader integrates robust background download management into Nextcloud:
- Send HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, Magnet links, and Torrent downloads to an external ND / Motrix download server - Fast multi-connection downloading powered by aria2 core - Live download progress, transfer speeds, and ETA tracking in the Nextcloud interface - Automatically imports finished downloads straight into your Nextcloud personal storage - Seamless integration inside Nextcloud Files "+ New" menu and drag-and-drop link support - Per-user download isolation so users only manage their own tasks - Configurable admin connection settings with encrypted secret token storage
info.author: NotUrNio
